title: Smooth way of getting to know top sights
text: Amazing way to roam around Barcelona in a small group and get all the important guidings and stories. Really liked the impressive  number of stories. Easy to use, thanks!
author: josefinea684

title: As a solo traveler Trales' audio guides was perfect
text: As a solo traveler the Trales audio guide really made my exploration easy and convenient. Full of stories about top sights and history.
author: 612alexander_

title: Flexible audio tourist guides
text: Fun, factual and snappy stories. Total flexibility. Worked great both walking and on bike. Best with headphones. Thanks!
author: Alexander_s

title: Really flexible and informative
text: Really fun way to explore Barcelona in our small group! Hundreds of audio stories, good mix between celebrities, historical events and landmarks. Stories pretty much everywhere!
author: 612alexander_
